title: Transit: wire IPFS write latency + queue depth to Prometheus
description: Transit already has /metrics endpoint and prometheus crate. Two gaps: (1) IPFS_WRITE_LATENCY_SECONDS histogram is registered in metrics.rs but never called - wire it into pipeline.rs run_pipeline() around the IPFS put_raw() call. (2) QueueMetrics in ingestion_queue.rs tracks depth_current/accepted_total/rejected_full_total atomically but these are never exposed to the Prometheus registry - add a gauge INGESTION_QUEUE_DEPTH and counters that mirror the QueueMetrics atomics.
